en.headline: Lee Ka-yi and Tang Ming-hong win Asian Games squash mixed doubles gold
en.dek: Hong Kong claimed gold and silver in the event after an all-SAR final at the Nagoya Kinjo Futo Arena on Sunday.
body: Lee Ka-yi and Tang Ming-hong won Hong Kong’s first gold medal in squash mixed doubles at the Asian Games, defeating teammates Toby Tse Yee-lam and Lai Cheuk-nam in the final on Sunday.

The all-Hong Kong final was confirmed on Saturday after both pairs advanced from the semi-finals. Lee and Tang had edged India’s Joshna Chinappa and Velavan Senthilkumar 2-1, while Tse and Lai beat Malaysia’s Rachel Arnold and Ameeshenraj Chandaran in straight games.

The result completes a historic gold-and-silver sweep for Hong Kong in the event. Simmi Chan earlier secured bronze in the women’s singles. The medals add to Hong Kong’s growing tally at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球混雙港隊包辦金銀 李嘉兒鄧銘漮奪金
zh.dek: 港隊兩對組合於名古屋決賽對壘，李嘉兒及鄧銘漮組合奪得金牌，港隊歷史性包辦金銀牌。
body: 香港壁球代表李嘉兒及鄧銘漮於亞運混雙決賽擊敗隊友謝依霖及賴卓楠，奪得金牌，港隊亦包辦銀牌。
兩對組合周六已分別晉級決賽。李嘉兒及鄧銘漮在準決賽以2比1擊敗印度組合，謝依霖及賴卓楠則直落兩局擊敗馬來西亞組合，確保港隊包辦金銀。
這是港隊在亞運壁球混雙項目的歷史性成績。早前陳善鈺亦在女子單打奪得銅牌，為港隊增添獎牌。
